entities.name: José Luis Lacunza Maestrojuán
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Luis Lacunza Maestrojuán, O.A.R., is a Spanish-born Panamanian Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of David from 1999 to 2024. He is a member of the Order of Augustinian Recollects. Pope Francis made him a cardinal in 2015.
